analysis.title: Organic Tea Editorial Landing Page
analysis.notes: A warm off-white page combines oversized charcoal and yellow typography with botanical tea photography, product mockups, and generous vertical spacing. The composition uses a loose editorial grid, overlapping imagery, and a sweeping yellow curve to connect product, flavor, and customization sections.
analysis.heroPrompt: Create a tall editorial wellness landing-page hero for an organic tea product, using a warm ivory background, bold oversized charcoal sans-serif typography, and a bright saffron-yellow accent. Arrange a white ceramic teapot, loose tea, green leaves, almonds, and dried citrus in a clean overhead still life with soft shadows, partially overlapping a thin black outlined product frame. Add subtle translucent oversized lettering behind the objects, generous negative space, delicate gray microcopy placeholders, and a refined asymmetrical magazine layout. Avoid logos, brand names, and legible marketing text.
